description: The GLiM v1.0 has been developed as tool for global modeling in a detail yet unmatched. The database contains about 1,2 million polygons. The average resolution is 1:3 750 000. The map is about 100 times more detailed than previous global lithological maps.

data.title: GLiM Global Lithological Map
data.description: The new global lithological map database GLiM, a representation of rock properties at the Earth surface.
